column1: # Environment: native-Linux host "sam" (Ubuntu 24.04, kernel 6.17, 8 cores, no VM layer;
# netem applies inside the mysql container netns exactly as in env-1).
# Purpose: paper §6 planned external-validity check. Holdout one-way RTT points
# 800us and 2200us were never measured in the original sweep (0/300/1500/5000/10000).
# RTT=0 cells re-fit environment-specific intercepts a'_style(N=100); holdout cells
# test the transferable model structure T = a' + b * roundtrips(style,N) * RTT_rt.
# Styles cover roundtrips classes: 0 extra (joinfetch, jdbc-join), 1 extra (inbatch,
# jdbc-inbatch), D(N) extra (lazy, byid). Scenario B, N=100, rate 20 (matches env-1
# B cells), 3 repeats per cell for within-cell dispersion.
